description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LogicHookTest' that tests various functionalities of the 'LogicHook' class within the SuiteCRM framework, including hook loading, initialization, and execution of logic hooks for the 'Accounts' module.

classes.name: LogicHookTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LogicHook class's behavior in SuiteCRM, including hook registration, retrieval, and execution.

methods.name: testinitialize
methods.description: Tests that LogicHook::initialize() returns an instance of the LogicHook class.

methods.name: testLogicHook
methods.description: Tests that creating a new LogicHook object does not throw an exception.

methods.name: testsetBean
methods.description: Tests that setBean method correctly sets the bean property and returns the LogicHook instance.

methods.name: testgetHooksMap
methods.description: Verifies that getHooksMap returns an array.

methods.name: testgetHooksList
methods.description: Verifies that getHooksList returns an array.

methods.name: testscanHooksDir
methods.description: Tests scanning of hooks directory and verifies the loaded hook map and list against expected values.

methods.name: testrefreshHooks
methods.description: Verifies that refreshHooks() executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testloadHooks
methods.description: Checks the loading of hooks for a specific module ('Accounts') and verifies against expected data or empties if files are missing.

methods.name: testgetHooks
methods.description: Verifies that getHooks returns the correct hooks data for 'Accounts', with and without refresh.

methods.name: testcall_custom_logic
methods.description: Ensures call_custom_logic executes without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: testprocess_hooks
methods.description: Validates that process_hooks executes properly without exceptions.
